title: When the Witness Wakes
author: Lena Ravensworth
blurb: Cyrus Iversen, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
